ease.reason: A fictional-input document checklist is approachable, but attached sources provide no health-safe workflow or implementation instructions.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a health-administration office may value help with document handling; this vacancy proves no AI-service demand.

feasibility.reason: A two-week mock could label fictional referral and outgoing-copy tasks, but the notice gives no fields or rules and no attached reference supports the mechanics.

autonomy.reason: A mock can prepare a checklist for review; staff must verify records and perform all real handling and sending.

evidence.reason: The fresh notice names referral, post and medical-copy tasks, but gives no frequency, inputs or operating constraints.

candidates.reason: Assessed a bounded checklist using fictional test records only; its equal-weight score is below 6 and no attached building reference supports its mechanics. Real deployment would need permission, access and privacy review.
